listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Eau de Parfum 200ml
listings.description: Montblanc Explorer captures the spirit of adventure in a bottle, blending fresh citrus with earthy woods for a scent that feels both refined and rugged. Launched as a modern interpretation of exploration, this fragrance balances brightness with depth, making it versatile enough for daily wear while still having enough character to stand out. The composition opens with a burst of bergamot and pink pepper before settling into a heart of sage and leather. As it develops, the woody base of vetiver, patchouli, and amberwood creates a warm, grounded finish that lingers throughout the day. The 200ml bottle offers excellent value if you've already discovered this is your signature scent. This Eau de Parfum works across seasons and occasions, fresh enough for warmer months yet substantial enough to hold its own when temperatures drop. The larger size means you won't need to restock frequently, making it a practical choice for those who wear it regularly. Fragrance Notes: Top Notes - Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Clary Sage Middle Notes - Vetiver, Leather Base Notes - Amberwood, Patchouli, Cacao

listings.rawTitle: MontBlanc Explorer Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Montblanc Explorer combines fresh bergamot with warm woods to create a fragrance that balances energy and sophistication. This scent captures an adventurous character without feeling overwhelming, making it suitable for everything from office wear to evening plans. The opening notes of bergamot and pink pepper give way to a heart of sage and leather, before settling into a base of vetiver, patchouli, and amberwood. The progression feels natural, with each layer adding depth without losing the freshness that defines the opening. The 100ml size offers a good balance between value and practicality. This Eau de Parfum performs well across different settings and seasons. The woody base provides enough warmth for cooler months, while the citrus top notes keep it from feeling too heavy during spring and summer. It's a versatile option for those who want one fragrance that adapts to various occasions. Fragrance Notes: Top Notes - Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Clary Sage Middle Notes - Vetiver, Leather Base Notes - Amberwood, Patchouli, Cacao

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Montblanc Explorer captures the thrill of discovery in a woody aromatic composition that feels both polished and adventurous. Launched in 2019, this fragrance draws on ingredients sourced from across the globe, weaving together freshness, warmth and a touch of leather for a scent that suits the modern man on the move. The journey begins with bright Italian bergamot, pink pepper and clary sage, creating an invigorating opening with just enough spice to intrigue. At the heart, Haitian vetiver and smooth leather add depth and sophistication. The trail settles into a rich base of Indonesian patchouli, akigalawood and cacao, leaving a warm, earthy finish that lingers without overpowering. This Eau de Parfum transitions well across seasons and settings, fresh enough for daytime wear yet grounded enough for evenings out. The compact 30ml bottle is ideal for travel or for those wanting to test whether Explorer deserves a permanent place in their rotation. Fragrance Notes: Top Notes: Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Clary Sage Middle Notes: Vetiver, Leather Base Notes: Patchouli, Akigalawood, Cacao, Ambroxan
